title: Greentech Environmental
description: Greentech Environmental LLC, a manufacturer of air purification systems using patented ODOGard and ARC technologies, has failed to fully secure and address the breach, and therefore we are publishing their confidential information such as (intellectual property/trade secrets, financial statements, employee data, operational/strategic plans, legal documents, corporate governance documents, and manufacturing drawings) that would violate the Defend Trade Secrets Act (CFAA) and state privacy laws, which would subject us to injunctive relief, treble damages, penalties, mandatory notification, class action lawsuits, loss of patent rights and competitive advantage, and possible business failure.
